items.title: LLM4CKD：用于慢性肾脏病早期筛查的大型语言模型
items.originalTitle: LLM4CKD: Large Language Models for Early Stage Chronic Kidney Disease Screening
items.summary: 本研究评估大型语言模型（LLMs）在零样本和少样本情境学习下筛查慢性肾脏病（CKD）的有效性，并与传统ML/DL方法比较。提出使用临床选择的表格特征和结构化提示模板的框架，无需任务特定训练。结果表明，LLMs在少量示例下能达到竞争性能，在低数据场景常优于传统方法，但性能随输入复杂度增加而不稳定；ML/DL/TFM模型则随数据增加一致提升。
items.abstract: Early screening of chronic kidney disease (CKD) is critical for timely intervention, yet most machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches require labeled data and model training, limiting their use in real-world screening settings. This study evaluates the effectiveness of large language models (LLMs) for CKD screening under zero-shot and few-shot in-context learning settings and compares them with traditional ML and DL methods. We propose a framework that uses clinically selected tabular features and…
keyFacts: 大型语言模型能否在零样本和少样本设置下有效进行慢性肾脏病早期筛查？
使用临床选择的表格特征和结构化提示模板，在零样本和少样本情境学习下评估LLMs性能，并与ML、DL和表格基础模型（TFM）基线及现有筛查工具比较。
LLMs仅用少量示例即可达到竞争性能，在低数据场景常匹敌或超越传统方法；但性能依赖模型且随输入复杂度增加而不稳定，ML/DL/TFM模型随数据增加更一致改进。

This limitation becomes critical in clinical contexts, including neonatology, where PE of preterm infants is used to support the assessment of spontaneous motility, a ke…

items.abstract: Vision-language pre-training and predictive world modeling provide robot policies with rich semantic and dynamic visual features, but their native action and visual-prediction objectives may omit critical physical and task structure while retaining control-irrelevant visual redundancy. We call this mismatch between visual richness and control utility the action-sufficiency gap. We investigate whether this gap can be bridged by guiding intermediate features to preserve three control-relevant structure in robotic ma…

提出了GIFT框架，包含几何对齐、可负担性预测和目标区域重建等训练时约束，并实例化到VLA和WAM模型。

items.title: 非局域魔法：闭式解与纯化魔法的等价性
items.originalTitle: Non-local Magic: closed-form solution and equivalence with magic of purification
items.summary: 非局域魔法量化了不能被局域幺正变换消除的双量子比特态的非稳定化子性。尽管定义自然，其评估通常需要困难优化。我们证明对于对数稳定化保真度，该优化允许依赖施密特谱的精确闭式解析解。我们引入纯化魔法，定义为混合态所有纯化中最小纯态魔法，并展示它自然引出自由态为归一化稳定子码投影子的资源理论。对数稳定化保真度下，纯化魔法具有基于Uhlmann保真度的距离公式。我们证明非局域魔法等于约化密度算子幺正轨道上纯化魔法的最小值。结果提供了非局域魔法的有效解析刻画和混合态资源理论解释。

items.summary: 四足机器人在复杂地形跑酷中展现出敏捷性，但自主跑酷导航仍待探索。我们提出多模态扩散策略(MulDP)，融合视觉感知、本体感觉和目标信息，生成时间连贯且具有预见性的导航速度指令，紧密耦合感知和具身控制。为训练MulDP，构建了首个四足跑酷导航数据集(QPND)，包含多样导航行为和复杂地形。模拟和真实实验表明，MulDP实现了稳健的长时自主导航和复杂地形穿越。
items.abstract: Quadruped robots have demonstrated impressive agility in parkour locomotion across complex terrains. However, most systems still rely on human intervention for high-level planning, and autonomous parkour navigation remains underexplored. The key challenges include fine-grained velocity regulation, long-horizon anticipatory behaviors, and tight coupling between perception and embodied execution. To address these challenges, we propose a Multimodal Diffusion Policy (MulDP) that integrates visual perception with robo…
keyFacts: 如何实现四足机器人在复杂地形上的自主跑酷导航？
提出多模态扩散策略MulDP，集成多模态输入生成连续速度命令，并构建了专用的数据集QPND。
在仿真和真实实验中，MulDP实现了稳健的长时导航和复杂地形穿越。

items.summary: 本文提出一种基于视觉的流水线，用于焊缝的近似定位，作为高精度测量前的初步阶段。方法包括多视角图像采集、语义分割识别焊缝、摄影测量重建工件，并将识别到的焊缝投影到重建模型中，以减少整体扫描工作量并提高数据采集效率。
items.abstract: Accurate identification of weld seam geometries is essential for automated robotic post processing operations such as grinding, finishing, and inspection. For large workpieces, complete surface scanning using high precision laser scanners or structured light sensors can be time consuming and often generates substantial amount of data that are not relevant. This paper presents an experimental vision based pipeline for the approximate localization of weld seams. This serves as a preliminary stage before high precisi…
keyFacts: 如何自动识别大型工件上的焊缝几何形状，以减少机器人后处理操作前的扫描工作量和数据量？
论文提出一种实验性视觉流水线，包括从多个视角捕获图像、使用语义分割识别图像中的焊缝、使用摄影测量重建工件，以及将识别的焊缝投影到重建模型中。
该方法旨在减少整体扫描努力并提高数据采集效率，作为高精度测量前的初步阶段。

This paper presents the development of a lunar landing simulation framework implemented in Julia at the European Space Agency (ESA), within the Argonaut lunar lander programme. ATLAS (Argonaut Tools for Landing Analysis and Simulation) is a modular suite of analysis and simulation tools that cover the complete descent an…

items.summary: 本文提出一个可解析处理的极小模型，在一个统一框架中描述磁序、电子、空穴和激子，涉及轨道依赖的局域交换。以CrSBr双层为例，模型预测与实验和从头算结果吻合，并给出光学选择规则中自旋与层赝自旋组合量子数的守恒，发现一系列亮暗激子态。
items.abstract: The recent discovery of excitons coupled to the magnetic order, and the consequent strong magneto-optic responses, in some van der Waals magnetic semiconductors has triggered intense activity at the interface of magnetism and semiconductor optics. Here, we present an analytically tractable minimal model that describes magnetic order, electrons, holes, and excitons within a unified framework, thereby capturing a wide range of phenomena. It treats the magnetic order and itinerant carriers to be comprised by distinct…
keyFacts: 如何构建一个统一的解析模型来捕捉层状磁性半导体中磁序与激子耦合的多种现象？

items.abstract: SALTED provides an open-source Python package for machine learning the quantum-mechanical electron density, $n(\mathbf{r})$, in molecular and condensed-phase systems based on input atomic coordinates and species. The program adopts a linear atom-centered decomposition of the electron density, which makes it highly transferable across diverse atomistic configurations sharing similar chemical environments. Because of this representation choice, SALTED is naturally interfaced with state-of-the-art electronic-structur…

items.summary: 本文讨论虚假量子关联：在一种因果结构中看似量子、但在另一种因果结构中有无需微调的自然经典解释的关联。存在一些因果结构，其非经典量子关联在另一结构中可经典解释，且不违反相对论约束。但也存在类似贝尔情形中的非经典关联，在任何替代结构中无微调经典解释。
items.abstract: In his seminal paper, Bell [Physics Physique Fizika 1, 195 (1964)] considers the correlations that result from space-like separated measurements on a pair of entangled particles. He uses relativity theory to motivate the Bell causal structure, then shows the existence of quantum correlations that cannot be explained classically within this causal structure. Classical explanations of such quantum correlations are possible in alternative causal structures, for instance, those that allow superluminal causal influence…
keyFacts: 是否存在虚假量子关联，使得某因果结构中的非经典关联在另一因果结构中有无需微调的经典解释？

items.originalTitle: Quantum thermalization achieves optimal approximate quantum error correction

items.originalTitle: Transversality Conditions for Boundary Constraints Defined by Differential Equations
items.summary: 当边界条件由微分方程定义时，最优控制问题的横截性条件是什么？本文提出了初始和最终时间的通用横截性条件，适用于由带侧条件的微分方程定义的边界条件。引入协调/非协调时钟时间和弱伴随余向量概念。在非协调时钟情况下，新条件揭示弱伴随余向量与边界微分方程的向量场正交的特殊情形，不同于经典端点流形正交。应用在三体问题中介绍。

keyFacts: 在Sisyphi Cavi，何种机制（液态水或CO2冰过程）驱动当前沟壑的形成或改造？
使用CRISM和OMEGA红外数据分析季节性地表冰的成分和物理状态，对比暗斑形成和沟壑改造的时间。
H2O冰未被检测为独立沉积，CO2冰在早春和仲春半透明；暗斑形成与沟壑改造时间不匹配，无证据支持液态水或CO2间歇泉驱动。
